notes.general_comments:
There was a good understanding of cell structure, the complementary base pairs in DNA, the structure of a
synapse, phototropism, and antibiotics.
Candidates are expected to be able to recall key terms in the syllabus such as biodiversity and assimilation.
Candidates need to read all of the information provide to ensure they are answering the question asked (for
example Question 1, 36 and 40) and interpret diagrams carefully (such as in Question 18, 28 and 35).
